text: Rana has a second interview at the council on 2 November 2026. She's properly nervous about the panel bit. Text her good luck the night before.
laila moving to leeds in jan, flat viewing sat
Cem's housewarming Friday. Bring something, he's vegan now.

So Dafydd finally heard back from the architecture firm, he got it, starts on 9 November 2026. His wife Carmen is thrilled because it means they can stop the long distance thing. Send him a congrats card and maybe a bottle of something for the first week.
sunil interview thurs 10am - ring him afterwards see how it went
Chantal's leaving do is off, she's staying on another six months after all.
Sofia and her partner Aarav are hosting a dinner on 14 November 2026 to celebrate the new flat. I'm doing dessert.
Thabo said his mum's been in hospital since last week. He's exhausted, back and forth every day. Check in with him over the weekend.
Aoife, coeliac. Don't forget for the party.
Kept thinking about what Aidan said, he's been applying for six months and nothing. Really low about it. I should send him that job board link and ask if he wants a coffee.
Jakub's moving out of Manchester end of March 2027, going back to Kraków to be closer to his dad.

okay so voice note, Eduardo, the one from Marta's work, not the cousin, Eduardo has his citizenship interview on the fifth of December and he's asked if I can drive him there that morning, so yes I said yes, need to put it in the calendar
Ryan's 30th — 22 Nov 2026, the Crown. He keeps going on about wanting a decent record player.
Carmen loves Japanese food, mentioned a ramen place near Mihai's flat she wants to try.
Kasia had the viewing for the two bed in Clapton yesterday, she liked it but the landlord wants six months up front. Ask her next week if they took it.
Layla - new job at the hospital trust, admin role, started Monday
Saskia invited me to her engagement party on 6 December 2026. Her fiancé Hamza is doing the speeches, apparently terrified.
Pick up boxes and tape before Saturday.

Aaliyah's driving test is the day before her interview, both in the week of 16 November 2026. She's a wreck. Message her the morning of the test, and again the day after to see how the interview went.
Lior got into the Masters at Edinburgh. Moving up there September 2027.
chat w Nasser at the bbq. his daughter starts uni in Bristol next year. he's v anxious abt it
Kevin's dog Biscuit had his op today, all fine. Kevin was a mess this morning but sounded better afterwards.
Marta works at the planning office, been there ages. Knows everyone in the housing team. Could be useful when I'm looking.
Jess and Kai's anniversary dinner is on Saturday, they've booked the place on the river. Five years. Don't forget a card.
Kwame got made redundant on Friday. Didn't see it coming at all. He's putting a brave face on but I could tell. Ring him midweek, and send him the contact at Dawit's company.
Marcus mentioned he's off to Lisbon for a week from 3 November 2026, then straight into a job interview the Monday after he gets back. Sounds busy, honestly.
Dawit Khan, "Dave" to everyone at work, is hosting the team Christmas meal 12 December 2026. Asked if I'd help sort the venue, I said I'd look at a couple tomorrow.
Rana's flat in Peckham fell through. Back to square one. She's looking at Lewisham now.
moving date confirmed 28 Nov 2026. van booked. I'm doing the kitchen first

Spoke to Laila on the phone for ages. Her brother Nasser is getting married in Cyprus in May 2027 and she's organising the hen do for his fiancée. She's stressed. Also her landlord is selling so she might have to move again in the spring.
Cem said Sunil's leaving drinks were Thursday but I missed them. Should message Sunil to say sorry and wish him luck at the new place.
Dr Banerjee — Chantal's mum — retiring in March 2027 after 35 yrs at the surgery. Chantal wants to throw her a surprise party, asked me to help with invites.
Sofia hates big parties, prefers small dinners. Keep that in mind for her birthday.
Tues - Thabo's interview at Deloitte. Weds - his flat viewing. Thurs - his sister's graduation. Busy week for him. Text him Weds evening.
Aoife's cat Mango went missing two days ago. Still nothing. She's gutted. Remind me to share the poster on the street group.
Aarav mentioned his parents are visiting from Pune for Diwali, staying three weeks. He's taking them to the Lake District the week after they land.
don't forget to chip in for Aidan's leaving present — Jakub collecting by Fri

Eduardo's partner Ryan just got offered the job in Glasgow, so they're relocating in February 2027. Eduardo's a bit torn, he loves his job here. Ask him how he's feeling about it next time we have lunch.
Mihai and Kasia housewarming tonight. Got wine.
Haven't heard from Layla since her interview at the BBC last Wednesday. Must message her.
Saskia's mum had her knee done on Monday. Saskia's staying with her for the week to help out afterwards.
Hamza Usman — met him at Kevin's party. Works in recruitment, said he'd look at my CV. Into climbing, goes to the wall on Holloway Road.
rent goes up in jan, need to decide by 1 December 2026 whether to renew

Long chat with Aaliyah over coffee. She's had three interviews for the comms manager role and the final one is on 19 November 2026, a presentation to the board. She's been rehearsing all week but the night before she always panics. Her flatmate Marta is helping her practise. Afterwards they're going out for dinner whatever happens. I should text her that morning, and call the day after to hear how it went.
Lior's grandad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is next Thursday in Haifa, he's flying out the day before.
Nasser's into vintage cameras, has a whole shelf of them. Kept talking about a Leica he can't afford.
Note for myself: the Kingsland Road flat viewing is at 6, bring payslips.
Kevin and Jess got engaged!! At the dinner on Saturday, he proposed between courses. Wedding probably summer 2027.
Kai's new role starts after the Christmas break, head of design. He got the promotion last week. Send congrats.
Kwame's little boy starts nursery on 4 January 2027. Kwame's more nervous than the kid.
Marcus says his flat in Bristol has a damp problem and the landlord won't fix it. Thinking about moving out by March 2027.
Dawit invited us to his 40th, a dinner on 21 November 2026. Then everyone's going to a club afterwards, which, no. I'll leave after dinner.
dictated — Rana, Laila and Cem all coming to mine on the 8th for dinner. Laila's veggie. Cem doesn't eat mushrooms. Rana's bringing her new boyfriend, Ryan I think.
Uncle Dafydd had his scan results back, all clear. Mum was crying on the phone, relieved.
Sunil's interview went well apparently, second round is 30 November 2026.
Chantal's sister Layla is pregnant, due in April 2027. Chantal's going to be an auntie for the first time and won't shut up about it.
Sofia mentioned she's started learning Portuguese before the move to Porto next summer. Ask her how the classes are going.
Thabo's birthday is 3 December. He collects whisky. A bottle of something Japanese would go down well.
Nothing much, just caught up with Aoife at the station.
Jakub had his first day at the new firm yesterday. Asked him how it went, said it was overwhelming but good. Check in with him again next week.
